item.title: Taika Waititi Says His Star Wars Movie Needs to Be ‘More of Its Own Thing’
item.description: Last week, Kathleen Kennedy shared an update on Taika Waititi's Star Wars film and just a few days later we hear from the star himself as he spoke to Variety at Sundance saying, “I’m just trying to go back and harness a little bit more of the fun from the original films”. item.title: Legendary Composer John Williams Joins Boston Symphony On Stage
item.description: Legendary Composer John Williams made a surprise appearance at the Boston Symphony's all-John Williams program on Thursday, coming on in a wheelchair at the end and taking a bow with Music Director Andris Nelsons, pianist Emanuel Ax, and violinist Gil Shaham. item.title: Rian Johnson is Looking Forward to Seeing More “Fresh Voices” Telling New Star Wars Stories
